description: This file contains the ContactMechWorker class with utility methods for handling contact mechanisms such as addresses and phone numbers within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and validating contact mechanism data, especially postal addresses, telecom numbers, and FTP addresses.

classes.name: ContactMechWorker
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for managing contact mechanisms such as addresses and phone numbers in OFBiz.

methods.name: insertRelatedContactElement
methods.description: Adds related contact element GenericValue objects (PostalAddress, TelecomNumber, FtpAddress) to the elementMap based on contactMechTypeId.

methods.name: getPartyContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanism value maps for a party, optionally filtered by contactMechTypeId and date.

methods.name: getFacilityContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanism value maps for a facility, optionally filtered by contactMechTypeId and date.

methods.name: getOrderContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanism value maps associated with an order.

methods.name: getWorkEffortContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanism value maps associated with a work effort.

methods.name: getEntityContactMechValueMaps
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve contact mechanism value maps for a generic entity view, with optional date filtering.

methods.name: getContactMechAndRelated
methods.description: Populates target map with contact mechanism and related data for a party, based on request parameters.

methods.name: getFacilityContactMechAndRelated
methods.description: Populates target map with contact mechanism and related data for a facility, based on request parameters.

methods.name: getFacilityContactMechByPurpose
methods.description: Finds the first facility contact mechanism matching a list of purposes, prioritized.

methods.name: getPartyPostalAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves postal addresses for a party, excluding the current contactMechId.

methods.name: getCurrentPostalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the current postal address and related info for a party and contactMechId.

methods.name: isUspsAddress
methods.description: Checks if a postal address matches USPS address patterns based on configuration.

methods.name: isCompanyAddress
methods.description: Determines if a postal address belongs to a specific company party based on address matching.

methods.name: getContactMechAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute value for a contact mechanism.

methods.name: getPostalAddressPostalCodeGeoId
methods.description: Determines the geoId for a postal address, using various lookup strategies.

methods.name: urlEncodePostalAddress
methods.description: Converts a PostalAddress GenericValue into a URL-encoded string suitable for use in URLs.
